# 🧰 Project Templates

| Template | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [ADR](adr-template.md) | Record a design decision |
| [Bug report](bug-report-template.md) | Capture reproducible defects |
| [Feature proposal](feature-proposal-template.md) | Define behavior and boundaries |
| [Test report](test-report-template.md) | Record compiler/test evidence |
| [Release checklist](release-checklist-template.md) | Prepare source/binary release |
| [Code review](code-review-template.md) | Review C safety and maintainability |
| [Compatibility matrix](compatibility-matrix-template.md) | Record compiler/OS evidence |
| [Security review](security-review-template.md) | Review input and memory risks |
| [Benchmark](benchmark-template.md) | Record performance observations |
| [User feedback](user-feedback-template.md) | Summarize usability feedback |
